text:
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod blocked for release 2026.03.18-42. Env parity check failed: prod keystore path '/keystore/text-gen/prod' missing secret 'primary_key'. Staging has it. See deploy logs: https://ci.internal/reports/2026/03/18/42

alice (release): Ugh. Was this a recent change in the chart or secret rotation?

bob (eng-sre): Running quick check... `kubectl get secret -n text-gen keystore-prod -o yaml` shows empty data.primary_key. Staging secret `keystore-staging` has a value.

carla (platform): Last helm values for this release changed keystore path to `/keystore/text-gen/{{ .Values.env }}` — should be identical but looks like prod path got truncated during templating. Could be value interpolation bug.

dave (infra): I can manually recreate secret from staging but prefer not to copy keys across envs without audit sign-off.

emma (security): +1 on audit. If we recreate we need KMS wrapping and an acl entry. Who has keys to unwrap?

alice (release): Options: 1) pause promotion and hotpatch chart to fallback to `keystore-legacy` (nonideal), 2) roll back to previous image tag in prod (safer), 3) recreate secret from staging with proper KMS wrap and audit. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

bob (eng-sre): Given we haven't verified data-plane with this new keystore path, I'd vote rollback to last-known-good image tag (sha: 7a9c3f). Minimizes blast radius.

carla (platform): Agree. Also push a quick validation job to catch templating output before next promotion. I can add a preflight that diffs secret names between envs.

dave (infra): I'll queue rollback. Command I'll run: `kubectl set image deploy/text-gen text-gen=redwood/text-gen:7a9c3f -n prod` and monitor healthchecks.

emma (security): If we recreate secrets later, I'll coordinate KMS unwrap/rewrap and log the operation. Create a ticket in security for the audit.

alice (release): Ok rollback plan accepted. @dave roll back now. @carla add preflight check and flag this release as blocked until parity is fixed. I'll update release notes and notify customer-facing teams.

dave (infra): Rolling back... `kubectl rollout restart deploy/text-gen -n prod` then set image. Healthchecks passing on pod 3/3.

bob (eng-sre): Saw rollout succeed, latency within normal bounds. Will run smoke tests: `/opt/test/bin/smoke text-gen --endpoint prod`

carla (platform): Preflight diff PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/compare/preflight/keystore-diff. Adds check to release pipeline.

emma (security): Ticket created SEC-2026-118 for secret recreation/audit.

alice (release): Noted. Follow-ups: 1) patch templating bug (carla), 2) add preflight diff (carla), 3) security audit if recreate (emma), 4) postmortem with root cause and timeline (bob/alice). I'll schedule a 30m incident sync in #incidents. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

bob (eng-sre): Adding a quick snippet to the postmortem draft: `env-parity-check: compare secret names and keys between staging and prod; fail promotion if mismatch.`

dave (infra): Logging the rollback command in deploy logs. Deploybot status updated.

deploy-bot: Promotion status: ROLLED_BACK -> release 2026.03.18-42 pinned to image redwood/text-gen:7a9c3f. Blocker recorded in release metadata.
